subject: HIPAA discovery follow-up: BAA options, PHI boundary proposal & hosting modes
messages:
From: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
To: lisa.chen@helixhealth.com, tom.alvarez@helixhealth.com
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-05T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: HIPAA discovery follow-up: BAA options, PHI boundary proposal & hosting modes

Hi Lisa / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we all have alignment: 

1) SOC 2 status: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (Security) in Q2 2026. I attached a one-page summary and can share the full report under NDA if needed.

2) BAA availability: Redwood offers a standard BAA for customers handling PHI. We can execute Redwood's BAA or review Helix's redlines — either is fine; legal prefers to start from our standard and iterate.

3) PHI handling boundaries (proposal):
   - Allowed in hosted & dedicated modes: patient identifiers, encounter notes, and clinical codes if you choose Redwood Dedicated or Private VPC.
   - Hosted (multi-tenant) option: we recommend limiting to de-identified data only.
   - Private deployment: full PHI allowed; supports VPC peering or on-prem package for air-gapped needs.

4) Eligible deployment modes for Helix's use-case (real-time triage + audit retention):
   - Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) — recommended for predictable latency and isolation.
   - Private VPC — if you require customer-managed networking and KMS.
   - On-prem air-gapped — possible for regulated pilots but longer lead time.

5) Action items / next steps:
   - Helix: confirm which PHI categories you plan to send in pilot (demographics, notes, images?) — Lisa to confirm by EOD 9/7.
   - Redwood: share standard BAA draft + SOC 2 summary (attached) — Stephanie to send today.
   - Security: Helix to send vendor questionnaire responses (we received the initial PDF today).
   - Engineering sync: Dev and Helix infra to schedule a 30m tech deep-dive on deployment options next week.

Attachments: Helix-Vendor-Questionnaire-20260903.pdf (from Helix), redwood-soc2-summary-202608.pdf, phi-handling-proposal-20260905.docx (draft).

If that matches your notes, I’ll open a DocuSign for the BAA and create a calendar invite for the tech sync.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Exec, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: lisa.chen@helixhealth.com
To: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: tom.alvarez@helixhealth.com, security@helixhealth.com
Date: 2026-09-05T19:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HIPAA discovery follow-up: BAA options, PHI boundary proposal & hosting modes

Thanks Stephanie — very helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: good to know. We will request the full SOC 2 Type II under NDA; security@helixhealth.com will follow up with an upload link.

- PHI categories for pilot: for phase 1 we plan to send demographics, encounter timestamp, and short clinician notes (no images). We will NOT send full DICOMs in the pilot.

- Deployment preference: we would prefer Redwood Dedicated if SLA/latency guarantees and data isolation are available. If pricing for dedicated is too high, Private VPC would be our second choice.

Action: I’ll confirm the PHI list formally by 9/07 morning. Security will send the completed vendor questionnaire back by end of day 9/08.

Also: can you confirm retention/ephemeral options for KV cache and whether we can opt-out of persistent logs for pilot traffic?

Regards,
Lisa Chen
Director, Digital Ops
HelixHealth
From: dev.patel@redwood.com
To: lisa.chen@helixhealth.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-06T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HIPAA discovery follow-up: BAA options, PHI boundary proposal & hosting modes

Hi Lisa — quick answers from the engineering side: 

- KV cache & logs: For Dedicated and Private VPC deployments we can configure KV cache retention windows (1h, 24h, 7d) and offer an opt-out so no persistent KV is stored. For Hosted multi-tenant, KV is ephemeral but we do recommend avoiding PHI.

- Audit logs: We can route audit logs into your S3 (Private VPC) or into Redwood-managed encrypted retention for Dedicated. Logs are encrypted at rest; retention policy is configurable.

- Network options: Dedicated supports strict subnet isolation and fixed IP egress. Private VPC supports customer-managed KMS and peering. On-prem package supports offline model serving (longer install).

I'll bring a short runbook to the tech sync showing exact config toggles (cache retention, tokenization hooks, ingress filters). Proposed slots: 9/09 10:00 or 9/10 14:00 PT — Stephanie, can you confirm invite?

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Principal Software Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference
